source_text: Design a device that clamps two flat plates together and releases them.
product_intent: A device that can secure two flat plates in a clamped state and subsequently release them.
user_intent_summary: Design a device that clamps two flat plates together and releases them.

clauses.text: Design a device that clamps two flat plates together and releases them.

requirements.statement: The device must be capable of clamping two flat plates together.

verification.observable: Ability to hold two flat plates in a secured position
verification.condition: When the device is actuated, it must secure the plates together

requirements.statement: The device must be capable of releasing the two flat plates.

verification.observable: Ability to separate two flat plates from a secured position
verification.condition: When the device is actuated, it must allow the plates to be separated

operating_scenarios.name: Clamping Operation
operating_scenarios.description: The device is actuated to secure two flat plates together in a clamped state.

operating_scenarios.name: Release Operation
operating_scenarios.description: The device is actuated to allow the two flat plates to be separated from a clamped state.
